title: Finite cohomology window for Hom out of a perfect algebraic-space complex
statement: Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ a quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]: every open cover of $|X|$ has a finite subcover, and the absolute diagonal is quasi-compact. Use its small etale structure sheaf $\mathcal O_X$, module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and unbounded derived category $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $C_X=D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ be the full subcategory with quasi-coherent cohomology [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]. Perfect means etale locally represented by a bounded complex of direct summands of finite free structure modules [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package]. For each perfect $P\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ there exist integers $a\le b$ such that, for every $F\in C_X$, if $\mathcal H^q(F)=0$ for every $a\le q\le b$, then $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_X)}(P,F)=0$.

proof.text: Put $D=P^\vee=R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(P,\mathcal O_X)$. By [lem-sfb-ringed-site-perfect-duality], $D$ is perfect. Apply [lem-sfb-space-perfect-uniform-tor] to $D$: it has quasi-coherent cohomology and Tor amplitude in some $[u,v]$. Choose $N\geq0$ from [lem-sfb-space-global-sections-amplitude]. Set $a=-N-v$ and $b=-u$. Then $a\leq b$ because $u\leq v$ and $N\geq0$. These integers depend on $X,P$, not on $F$.

source.place: Tag 09MB, lemma-ext-from-perfect-into-bounded-QCoh, proof of (1); equivalent truncation-tail form of its tensor spectral-sequence calculation.

proof.text: Let $F\in C_X$ have zero cohomology on $[a,b]$. Use [lem-sf-derived-truncation-triangle] at $a$ to form $A\to F\to B\to A[1]$ with $A=\tau_{\leq a-1}F$ and $B=\tau_{\geq a}F$. Thus $A$ has zero cohomology above $a-1$. For $i\geq a$ the long exact cohomology sequence identifies $\mathcal H^i(B)$ with $\mathcal H^i(F)$, since both adjacent cohomology sheaves of $A$ are zero. Hence $B$ has zero cohomology below $b+1$: below $a$ by truncation and from $a$ to $b$ by the hypothesis on $F$. Similarly $\mathcal H^i(A)=\mathcal H^i(F)$ below $a$, and all other cohomology sheaves of $A$ vanish. Consequently both $A,B$ have quasi-coherent cohomology.

source.place: Tag 09MB, lemma-ext-from-perfect-into-bounded-QCoh, proof of (1); equivalent truncation-tail form of its tensor spectral-sequence calculation.

proof.text: The module-sheaf category has a closed additive symmetric tensor by [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed], is Grothendieck by [lem-pur-ringed-site-grothendieck-abelian], and has functorial flat resolutions by [lem-trf-site-functorial-flat-resolution]. Thus the categorical tensor bounds apply to its K-flat derived tensor. By [lem-sc-source-tor-amplitude-upper-tensor-bound], $D\otimes^{\mathbf L}A$ has no cohomology above $v+a-1=-N-1$. By [lem-sc-source-tor-amplitude-lower-tensor-bound], $D\otimes^{\mathbf L}B$ has no cohomology below $u+b+1=1$. Both tensors have quasi-coherent cohomology by [lem-sfb-space-derived-qcoh-pullback-tensor].

source.place: Tag 09MB, lemma-ext-from-perfect-into-bounded-QCoh, proof of (1); equivalent truncation-tail form of its tensor spectral-sequence calculation.

proof.text: Tensor the triangle of Step 2 with $D$. This preserves the distinguished triangle by [lem-sc-source-kflat-tensor-left-triangulated], using a K-flat representative supplied by [lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent]. Apply $R\Gamma(X,-)$ to that triangle; it preserves distinguished triangles by [lem-pc-right-derived-functor-triangulated]. By [lem-sfb-space-global-sections-amplitude], its first term has zero cohomology in all degrees greater than $(-N-1)+N=-1$, and its third term has zero cohomology below $1$. The degree-zero part of the long exact sequence therefore has zero groups on both sides of $H^0R\Gamma(X,D\otimes^{\mathbf L}F)$, which is consequently zero.

source.place: Tag 09MB, lemma-ext-from-perfect-into-bounded-QCoh, proof of (1); equivalent truncation-tail form of its tensor spectral-sequence calculation.

proof.text: The evaluation isomorphism of [lem-sfb-ringed-site-perfect-duality] identifies $D\otimes^{\mathbf L}F$ with $R\mathcal Hom(P,F)$ in the derived category. Taking zeroth derived global sections and using [lem-pur-rhom-global-sections] gives $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_X)}(P,F)\cong H^0R\Gamma(X,D\otimes^{\mathbf L}F)=0$, as required.
